sentences.l2: 很多国家不喜欢塑料垃圾。
sentences.l1: Many countries do not like plastic waste.

sentences.l2: 塑料垃圾很多，会伤害动物，会让环境不干净。
sentences.l1: There is a lot of plastic waste; it will harm animals and will make the environment unclean.

sentences.l2: 一些国家开始做新规定。
sentences.l1: Some countries have begun to make new regulations.
They say: "Plastic bags cannot be sold."

sentences.l2: 政府会看谁卖塑料袋，这是监管。
sentences.l1: The government will watch who sells plastic bags; this is regulation.

sentences.l2: 其他国家也这样做，这是全球趋势。
sentences.l1: Other countries also do this; this is a global trend.
Everyone wants to stop plastic pollution.

sentences.l2: 人们可以用布袋子，布袋子可以洗，可以再用。
sentences.l1: People can use cloth bags; cloth bags can be washed and can be used again.
